name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-ix-final-battle
title: Final Fantasy IX - Final Battle
description:
Necron's battle theme from FF9, using MM7/RM&F samples. I took some liberties with instrument choices and mixing, so don't expect it to be super accurate, also the first and last parts of the song were cut out.

Note: not compatible with "Bonus End" song and Thunder SFX/Blarggs.
